document: Reduce Discrimination: option to omit birthplace in passports & driving licenses, We think birthplace is outdated for identification, as fingerprints offer higher accuracy. Please add option to omit place of birth from passport & driving license, as you can do in places like Canada & Japan. We think requiring birthplace inclusion increases discrimination risk & privacy invasion., We think immigrants who’ve worked hard, paid taxes still aren’t seen as 'actually one of us.' For some, birthplace could trigger trauma from war or occupation—why risk being reminded of it when verifying ID or age? Article 8 of European Convention on  Human Rights guarantees the Right to Private Life, which we feel the UK has signed yet fail to fully defend.

Enforce trade and weapon laws: stop online traders selling knives to children, We think the government needs to ensure overseas online retailers are abiding to UK trade law and weapons laws when selling bladed articles online, as we believe some retailers may be using cheap delivery services who may not follow ID processes which could allow under 16s to access weapons., With many young people in the country becoming victims of child criminal exploitation, we think there is evidence that children are accessing weapons, supposedly to defend themselves, through cheap e-trader websites. Over the past 10 years knife crime has increased by 80%. In the year to March 2024, there were over 50,000 blade-related crimes in the England and Wales (excluding Greater Manchester). We think companies target children, selling knifes at pocket money prices and using cheap delivery services who may not check ID, often posting items through doors.

12 month minimum sentence and 6 month rehabilitation course for knife carrying, This could act as a deterrent and contribute to the reduction of knife-related crimes.
 
Introduce 12 month mandatory minimum sentence, including for 1st time offenders. Implement a mandatory 6-month knife awareness course for rehabilitation as part of the sentencing process., My son Harley Barfield, a vibrant 16-year-old boy, was stabbed 12 times in an attack in Haverhill Suffolk on 9th January 2023. He lost his fight for life on 11th January 2023.
 
It was an ordinary day, just after school let out, and he was attacked in broad daylight.

Show  episode of mason (coronation street) death due to knife crime in schools, This episode highlights not only the dangers and outcome of what happens when carrying a knife or sharp object it shows how it effects everyone around the crime. It is relatable to young children and could make a great impact on knife crime in communities, I want the government to help with getting this done knife crime has rose in the last 10 years in England and Wales it's time to make a change

Save Cane Corso for being banned in the UK, We, the undersigned, respectfully request that the UK Parliament reconsider any potential legislation aimed at banning or restricting the Cane Corso breed. This breed, known for its loyalty, intelligence, and protective instincts, is often misunderttood due to its size., 1. We ask Parliament to oppose any legislation that seeks to ban or restrict the Cane Corso breed.
2. We urge the government to recognize that breed-specific legislation (BSL) does not address the root causes of dangerous behavior in dogs, which are primarily the result of poor training, lack of socialization, and irresponsible ownership.
3. We request that the UK government focus on promoting responsible dog ownership through education, training requirements, rather than imposing breed bans.

Extend the 2007 workplace smoking ban and 2015 car smoking ban to include vapes, Extend the 2007 workplace smoking ban to include the use of vapes in a workplace and extend the 2015 ban on smoking in a car with a child to also include vapes., We think that extending smoking bans to include vapes could decrease second-hand exposure to potentially harmful chemicals for individuals with lung conditions such as asthma and for people who do not want to be exposed to vapor.
 
Restricting vaping in public spaces could also reduce its visibility to youth decreasing its appeal and protecting younger generations from developing nicotine addictions. We think that including vapes in these smoking bans promotes fairness and consistency, creating a unified policy to safeguard public health.

Make aggressive social media auditing a criminal offence, Social media auditing is the past-time of a person, usually referred to as an "auditor", visiting a location with the intention of exercising their rights to film and take photographs at that location. They later upload their footage of the location to social media., We believe social media auditors often attend private or otherwise sensitive locations in an active effort to seek confrontation with the occupiers or staff there. We believe they do this as it makes for more "entertaining" footage to share via social media, which in turn generates more publicity and revenue for them. We believe auditors often behave aggressively and refuse to leave private property. We believe a specific offence could prevent them from being a nuisance in this manner.

Make assaulting a security worker a standalone offence, Security workers play a vital role in maintaining public safety, but can face violence and abuse while performing their duties. Despite their critical role in protecting businesses, venues, and the public, security workers lack the legal protections afforded to emergency workers and shop workers., We think the government must address this by enacting specific legislation making assaulting a security worker a standalone offence.
 
Security are often first responders to incidents of crime and violence, yet, we feel they get little recognition or statutory protection, leaving them vulnerable. A dedicated offence could serve as a deterrent and an acknowledgment of their role in protecting public safety. We would want legal protections in line with those for emergency and retail staff.

Fund more support for armed forces veterans when they leave, We are calling for the government to fund more support for armed forces veterans when they leave the military, particularly in relation to their recovery from accident and injury and the Armed Forces Compensation Scheme., We think it is clear that veterans feel let down on a wide range of areas including housing, healthcare, employment, mental health, accident and injury.

Make bullying a specific criminal offence, We would like the government to make bullying a specific criminal offence. We do not want it to come under harassment and employment laws or other offences. , We want bullying to be against the law in its own right to cover and protect vulnerable people who might not be protected under the current law.

We want to protect children who are bullied on a daily basis who end up with mental health issues. We also want to protect adults who are subjected and targeted by other adults but it might not be deemed as against any current laws. Due to the sometimes coercive nature and gaslighting of bullying, I feel there is very little protection for people.

End the UK’s membership of the World Health Organisation, The World Health Organisation is not a democratically elected body and we are concerned about the powers WHO may be given over Sovereign Nations in the future., We think that ending the UK’s membership of the World Health Organisation is important for the sovereign governance of our country.

Increase the minimum sentence for the possession and use of a knife, I want the minimum sentence for the possession of a knife in public place to be 5 years, and 10 years for a repeat offence. I believe that if a knife is used to exert fear or hurt others, there must be a 10-year minimum sentence., I believe there has been a large increase in the current use of knives in crime and I believe there has been no relative punishment brought in to manage it or even discourage it. How many more people have to die?

Require all household knives to have blunt ends, Require knife manufacturers to change the design of household knives to include blunt ends. We think blunt-ended knives could make it harder for people to commit knife attacks., We think this could help prevent knife attacks which can end in the death of children and adults due to the ease with which a knife can penetrate the skin. We do not think it would stop the use of of knives for household tasks.

Petition To Scrap Breed Specific Legislation (BSL) In The UK, We want the UK Government to repeal Breed Specific Legislation across the UK and replace it with fairer, more compassionate evidence based policies that focus on education and promoting responsible dog ownership rather than just the outward appearance and measurements of a dog., We call on the UK Government to repeal Breed Specific Legislation (BSL) under the Dangerous Dogs Act 1991 and replace it with breed-neutral, evidence-based policies focusing on responsible ownership. BSL unfairly targets dogs based on appearance, not behaviour, and has proven ineffective in reducing attacks. Resources should be used to tackle neglect, poor training, and irresponsible ownership. Introduce education and behavioural assessments to improve safety and fairness. Scrap BSL now.

Change the legal age that a child should be rear facing till., A child can rear face right up until the age of 7/8 or specific height and weight measurements. Rear facing has proved to be a lot more safer than forward facing however because people see ff is legal they do it. We need the legal age to be changed for people to listen!, All we hear is of accidents happening, children being injured or hurt etc. however a lot of accidents of children rear facing have walked away without a scratch. It’s sad people only do what safest, if it’s legal. Parents aren’t always educated on the safest way to have their child in a car. It doesn’t help when pages like local police are posting about care safety when it isn’t the safest measures.

Introduce military service sentences for carrying a bladed weapon, We want people who are caught carrying a bladed weapon to be sentenced to service in military boot camps., We are tired of seeing young innocent lives taken, our areas crumble, crime and the fear it creates in society. We're tired of knife crime and we feel insufficient action has been taken and there's no deterrent.

Allow Gluten-Free applicants to join the British Army, Change the ruling on (otherwise fit and healthy) gluten-free applicants being classed as unfit in army applications., Gluten-Free ration packs aren’t available in the Armed Forces whilst other special dietary requirements (ie. Vegetarian) are being catered for. We think the Armed Forces should be able to accommodate the people who would be otherwise eligible to serve their country.

Change law so people over 16 get a whole life term if they commit knife crime, We think that action on knife crime has to be taken. We want the government to introduce stronger sentencing for carrying weapon without a lawful excuse and for offenders over 16 to receive a mandatory whole life term., We feel the UK has been blighted by murders of children committed by children or young adults. One knife death is one too many.

Scrap the 100ml rule for hand luggage in airports, I want the government to scrap the 100ml liquid rule for hand luggage in airports. The previous government planned to scrap it by June 2024 and it’s been over 9 months. The 100ml liquid rule is really difficult to comply with because most day to day essentials are above 100ml.,

Scrap the UK Armed Forces’ blanket ban on recruits with diabetes, We want the government to end the blanket ban on recruiting individuals with diabetes into the Armed Forces. We think the policy should be updated to allow those who can manage their condition effectively to serve, especially in non-physically demanding roles like cyber security and intelligence., We feel the current ban on recruiting individuals with diabetes is outdated and inconsistent, particularly when service members with the condition can remain in the Armed Forces if well-managed. We think excluding capable recruits from critical roles, like cyber security, due to a medical condition is discriminatory and limits the pool of skilled personnel. With widespread skill shortages, particularly in high-demand areas, we think it's crucial to create a more inclusive Armed Forces, following the example of progressive nations like Finland.

Do not extend the BBC TV license fee to streaming services, It has been reported that the Government is considering extending the BBC TV license fee to active subscribers of popular streaming services such as Netflix as an example. We believe this is unfair and that the Government has no rights to extend what we think is an unfair charge., We do not want the government to do this. The BBC do not contribute funding towards these streaming services. We believe the Government should instead come up with an alternative funding model for the BBC, such as adverts or an optional subscription, or scrap the license fee.

Make "Stolen Valour" a Criminal Offence, We would like the Government to make the act of "Stolen Valour" a Criminal Offence. Stolen valour involves falsely claiming military service, rank or medallic recognition.
 
We would like the offence to include the wearing of uniform and/or medals not awarded to the individual., We believe that current legislation is not effective enough and there have been several recent cases. It is a huge insult to those who have fought for our country, those injured and those who have paid the ultimate sacrifice and lost their lives.
 
Currently, only a few European countries adopt the same position as the UK as evidenced in the House of Commons Library research briefing ""Stolen Valour": An 
international comparison", dated 9th July 2024.

Treat unmarried couples the same as married couples for inheritance tax, To update the inheritance tax on unmarried couples to be the same as married couples. Currently it stands at 40% and married couples pay nothing if left inheritance by their spouse., Our story is shared by many. When confronted with the loss of a life partner, these individuals may be left fending against massive inheritance tax liabilities of 40%
 
We think this disparity in treatment is not only unjust but severely outdated. In the UK, research suggests around 3.6 million people cohabit, many with families. We seek equality in treatment under inheritance tax laws, allowing us to continue providing a stable environment for our families in times of grievous loss.

Repeal the Investigatory Powers Act, The Investigatory Powers Act gives the government additional powers to access encrypted data, which we feel threatens privacy and security. This petition calls for the repeal of this Act, as we believe it undermines individual freedom, risks data security, and could set a dangerous global precedent., We call on the government and Parliament to respect individuals’ right to privacy by rejecting any powers that compel companies to provide access to encrypted data. We believe encryption is crucial to protect personal information, ensure security, and preserve freedom of speech. We believe compromising encryption weakens digital security, increases risks of data breaches, and sets a dangerous precedent that could undermine privacy rights worldwide. We want to protect these fundamental freedoms.

Make substance use during pregnancy and breastfeeding a specific offence, We believe this would reduce the risks posed by substance use during pregnancy and breastfeeding, which would protect both mothers and children. Alongside making it a specific offence with legal consequences, there should also be an offer of support and rehabilitation for those affected., This proposal is aimed at protecting unborn children and infants from the harmful effects of substance use. While it aims to criminalise substance use during pregnancy and breastfeeding, it also prioritises the provision of support, education, and rehabilitation. We believe this balance would help ensure that mothers and children receive the help they need while holding individuals accountable for any health risks caused by substance use.

Ban Zombie knives and machetes., Outlaw the possession of these weapons.  Ban the sale of these weapons.  They add no value to our society., These weapons are not required for people living in the UK.  They are only required to create violence and terror for the general public.

Require schools to teach students about knife crime as part of the curriculum, We want the government to raise awareness about knife crime and add it to the primary and secondary school curriculums. We think this could help the knife crime rate go down and make children aware so when they grow up they might be less likely to do it., We think educating children from a young age about knife crime could help solve the issue

Ban online sales of cameras disguised as household items, I think cameras disguised as household items are sinister tools readily available online and can strip us of our privacy. I'm concerned they could invade people's privacy in public and private environments., I think the ease with which these invasive products can be obtained is alarming. I think it's time to intervene and ban the sale of these items.

Expel all US military personnel from military bases in the UK, We call for the Government to expel all US military personnel and equipment from the UK. We believe this will protect the UK and its European allies., We believe the US’ recent actions mean it is no longer appropriate to offer military installations from which the US can operate. We believe the US Administration’s recent comments about NATO mean the US should have no operational reason to remain in the UK

Create a specific offence to prevent harassment of people breastfeeding, The Breastfeeding etc. (Scotland) Act 2005 makes it an offence to prevent/stop a person feeding a child milk in a public place., In England & Wales The Equality Act states it is discrimination to treat a woman unfavourably because she is breastfeeding. We think this is insufficient protection and that the law in England is not enough of a deterrent. We feel the current law leaves mothers vulnerable.

Funding to reduce long waiting lists for urgent cardiology appointments, I think there is a crisis in long cardiology wait times. I've waited over 10 weeks for treatment, with an another 10 weeks expected. I believe the system's inefficiencies could worsen my health. Over 120,000 died in 2022 waiting for NHS care. I think immediate reform is essential, I think the Government must provide funding to reduce urgent wait lists to 4-6 weeks and expand provider access. I think this is crucial for timely healthcare, protecting UK lives, and preventing further losses from systemic inefficiencies.

Ban the use of Zombie Knifes in the UK and harsher punishment coming with Knives, I want for my community to be more safe when going around areas around London. I want for there to be more rules and harsher punshiments when people get convicted when they get arrested for the use in Knife Crime, I want you for the government to do it because right now especially in the UK more and more people are using Knifes which is shattering their dreams and ruining their life and their future. And i want to prevent that and give everyone a fair way to chase their dreams.

Require online knife purchases to be collected in-person from the Post Office., We urge the Government to require the purchase of knives online to be collected in-person from the post office, with purchasers required to provide two types of ID, to help identify if people are providing false documents., We believe a lot of violence with knives comes from the use of kitchen knives. We  think that this policy could help give police a better chance to prevent crime from occurring.

Make 'Tragedy Chanting' at football stadia a specific criminal offence, I want the government to legislate to eradicate the vile, triggering act of mocking death on the football terraces of Britain. I wish for the government to make 'Tragedy Chanting' a specific criminal offence, The act of tragedy chanting is disgusting to hear, and vile to witness.
It can be triggering for any football fan going to the game, who is, or has been affected by a football disaster.
This is not just for A club, this is for ALL clubs, supporters, anyone affected by this vile practise. It is my sole aim, to make it an illegal act, but also to teach the younger fans about truths, and getting rid of this act early on.

Review IVF guidelines for women whose partner already has a child , Review guidelines and criteria for women who are facing fertility issues to access IVF treatment on the NHS regardless of if their partner has a child from a previous relationship. We believe all women should have the chance to become a mother to a biological child., We consider that some women are being told they can’t receive NHS IVF treatment because their partner has a child from a previous relationship. We believe this is making women facing fertility issues feel punished. We think women should not be denied NHS IVF if they have a fertility issue regardless of partners previous child/children. We are concerned that the impact this may have on women struggling to conceive is immense and, in our view, it should not be taken lightly.

Allow Type 1 diabetics to be individually assessed to join the Armed Forces, We urge the Government to allow Type 1 diabetics to be individually assessed for military service. We think the current blanket ban disregards medical advancements and individual capability. We feel a fair, case-by-case assessment could ensure skilled, committed individuals aren’t excluded., We think the military’s blanket ban on Type 1 diabetics is outdated. With advancements like artificial pancreas pumps, many can effectively manage their condition. We feel this policy prevents capable, skilled individuals from serving their country. We think individual assessments could ensure decisions are based on ability, not just diagnosis. A fair system could open opportunities for dedicated recruits while maintaining operational effectiveness.

Call for a ceasefire in South Sudan & more humanitarian aid access, We call on the Government to call for an immediate ceasefire in South Sudan to prevent further loss of life and humanitarian suffering, and to call for more humanitarian aid access for humanitarian organisations so that they can provide urgent assistance to affected communities., We are very concerned by reports of bombardments and the use of weapons on civilians in Nasir and Longechuk in the Upper Nile State in South Sudan.

Make the climate emergency a lawful excuse in criminal cases, Make the climate emergency a lawful excuse in criminal damage and other such cases. , We think that if the defendant is motivated by what we think is the urgent and all encompassing need to protect human life on Earth and do whatever they can to do this, then that is relevant to the case. 
 
We think climate protests, although inconvenient, are vital to conserve life, so we feel the reasons for doing these actions are fundamentally relevant.

Scrap the 2035 petrol and diesel car ban, We do not think that electric vehicles are suitable for the majority. They can be expensive to buy, repair, insure and charge (using public chargers). Modern petrol and diesel cars do not pollute as much as they used to., Scrap the ban and allow sales to
Continue

Do not sign a trade deal with the USA, We urge the Government to not sign a trade deal with the USA, We believe that a trade deal could seriously harm British Manufacturing, British Farming, and the NHS. We are concerned it could lower food standards and could affect our rights.

Pedestrian crossing at Ledbury and Colville Road junction with Lonsdale road, Immediate action is needed to create a safer environment and protect the lives of our community’s youngest members. 
Pedestrian crossings are a critical safeguard, preventing Colville primary school students  from being put at risk by speeding cars and double-decker buses in residential areas., Introduce two pedestrian crossings at the junction Ledbury Road and Lonsdale Road 
And Colvile Road and Lonsdale Road

Legalise Everyday Carry of Folding Pocket Knives with Common Locking Mechanisms, I urge the UK government to include common pocket knife locking mechanisms—such as frame locks, liner locks, back locks, and button locks—under the everyday carry (EDC) exemptions. This change would legalise a wide range of commonly used pocket knives intended for routine, practical tasks., I believe the addition of a locking mechanism to pocket knives does not increase the risk to public safety; however, it significantly improves user safety by preventing the blade from accidentally folding onto the user's fingers—a frequent cause of injury during normal use.
I believe permitting such mechanisms would substantially reduce injuries caused by folding pocket knives, thereby alleviating unnecessary pressure on NHS A&E departments.

Stop Government geoengineering experiments to "dim the sun", Stop the Government's planned £50 million project to "dim the sun" and making geoengineering of any kind illegal in the UK., On the 22.04.25, The Telegraph reported that: "Experiments to dim sunlight to fight global warming will be given the green light by the Government within weeks. Outdoor field trials could include injecting aerosols into the atmosphere, or brightening clouds to reflect sunshine, are being considered by scientists. Aria, the Government’s advanced research and invention funding agency, has set aside £50 million for projects."

We want to stop this and make geoengineering illegal in the UK.

Funding so every under 1 in A&E, urgent care, paediatrics to have urine sample, I want every baby under one in these services to be fully checked out with a urine sample. I think this would help early detection and treatment of sepsis.,

Ban songs about knife crime and violence on social media and music apps, Social media platforms and music apps may allow children to listen to music talking about knives and crime. I want a ban on music that I think glamorises this lifestyle.,

Ban balaclavas to prevent crime, I want the government to totally ban balaclavas. I do not think there is any need for them because we do not have arctic conditions in this country. Stop people from selling them and arrest and fine people who are found wearing them., The crime rate is too high and I am concerned about people driving cars into shops with balaclavas on. There are too many stabbings and murders and I'm concerned that balaclavas mean people cannot be identified.

End the face tattoo ban in UK Armed Forces, Lift the ban of face tattoos in our military., With our military actively lacking personnel, we think there should not be ignorant rules in place refusing citizens with tattoos on the face from serving. We think it’s preventing many people who simply want a better future and people who want to serve our country from joining the Armed Forces, at a time when we lack the number of personnel we need. We believe that a person should be able to serve as long as they are fit enough to serve, whether that's a man or woman. We consider that tattoos do not define a person unless obscene or offensive. Many would die for our country even.

Raise the annual limit on Commonwealth recruits for the UK Armed Forces, We think the limit of 1,350 should be raised. Many commonwealth citizens would commit long term and positively contribute to British Society., It is reported the UK Armed Forces is losing an average of 300 more members than they recruit each month. I believe it makes little sense to limit commonwealth citizen recruits, including limiting the Royal Navy to only 300 per year. According to the Defence Journal, the Royal Navy and British Army only achieved 60% & 63% of its target recruitment respectively last year. I believe Commonwealth applicants who are motivated and willing to serve our nation should not be restricted from joining the UK military.

Stop fines for taking children out of school on holiday, Stop fines for taking our children out of school on holiday. Where does the money actually go when we are fined for taking our children away and showing them different cultures? Scrap the fines!, We want the government to stop the fines for taking our children out of school on holiday and showing them the world without it costing a small fortune that some parents can’t afford! We think holidays are educational. Why should we be fined they are our children.

Change the law so neighbours cannot record in to private back gardens, I want the law to change so neighbours cannot record others' gardens with their own security cameras., I want it to be illegal to use any sort of camera device to record your neighbour's back garden. I think right to privacy should mean your neighbours should not be able to be record you. I think it’s not right and children should be protected from possible predators.
